source_handle: *38 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local povidone-iodine disinfection and alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride were performed. After the anesthesia took effect, the gums were separated. The crown part was cut and divided with a mobile phone to remove the mesial obstruction. The pieces were loosened and the tooth extraction forceps were removed. The tooth extraction wound was routinely scratched and sutured (1 stitch) to stop bleeding.
